name: 111 - Core - Apply Channel Rate Limiting - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS client_id,
        $2::INTEGER AS max_requests,
        $3::INTEGER AS window_seconds
),

client_context AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,

        client.id AS registered_client_id,
        client.enabled AS client_enabled,

        CASE
            WHEN client.id IS NULL
                THEN FALSE
            ELSE TRUE
        END AS client_exists

    FROM request_data request
    LEFT JOIN channel_gateway_clients client
        ON client.id = request.client_id
),

window_context AS (
    SELECT
        context.*,

        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            FLOOR(
                EXTRACT(
                    EPOCH FROM NOW()
                ) /
                context.window_seconds
            ) *
            context.window_seconds
        ) AS window_start

    FROM client_context context
),

updated_counter AS (
    INSERT INTO channel_rate_limit_counters (
        client_id,
        window_start,
        window_seconds,
        request_count,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.client_id,
        context.window_start,
        context.window_seconds,
        1,
        NOW()
    FROM window_context context
    WHERE context.client_exists = TRUE
      AND context.client_enabled = TRUE
    ON CONFLICT (
        client_id,
        window_start,
        window_seconds
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        request_count =
            channel_rate_limit_counters.request_count + 1,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN context.client_exists = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.client_enabled = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN counter.id IS NULL
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN counter.request_count <=
             context.max_requests
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS allowed,

    CASE
        WHEN context.client_exists = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_not_found'

        WHEN context.client_enabled = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_disabled'

        WHEN counter.id IS NULL
            THEN 'rate_limit_counter_not_created'

        WHEN counter.request_count <=
             context.max_requests
            THEN 'rate_limit_allowed'

        ELSE 'rate_limit_exceeded'
    END AS result,

    context.client_id,

    COALESCE(
        counter.request_count,
        0
    ) AS request_count,

    context.max_requests,
    context.window_start,

    context.window_start +
      MAKE_INTERVAL(
          secs => context.window_seconds
      ) AS window_end,

    CASE
        WHEN counter.id IS NULL
            THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(
            context.max_requests -
            counter.request_count,
            0
        )
    END AS remaining_requests,

    CASE
        WHEN counter.id IS NULL
            THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(
            CEIL(
                EXTRACT(
                    EPOCH FROM (
                        context.window_start +
                        MAKE_INTERVAL(
                            secs =>
                              context.window_seconds
                        ) -
                        NOW()
                    )
                )
            )::INTEGER,
            0
        )
    END AS retry_after_seconds,

    context.client_exists,

    COALESCE(
        context.client_enabled,
        FALSE
    ) AS client_enabled

FROM window_context context
LEFT JOIN updated_counter counter
    ON counter.client_id =
       context.client_id;

parameters.content:
## Rate Limiting — Corrected V2

پیش از ساخت Counter، وجود و فعال‌بودن Gateway Client بررسی می‌شود.

در صورت نامعتبر بودن client_id، Workflow به‌جای خطای Foreign Key یکی از پاسخ‌های زیر را برمی‌گرداند:
- gateway_client_not_found
- gateway_client_disabled

برای تست دستی از شناسه واقعی خروجی Workflow 112A استفاده کن.
